artist.name: The Untitled One
artist.bio: The Untitled One is a Bengaluru drum and bass DJ and a co-founder of Drum and Bass India, which he started in 2013, and he runs the Bangalore Massive nights. His radio show and club night Sub-Titles ran on boxout.fm, and he has shared the decks with Netsky and Goth Trad.

eras.sound: Drum and bass from rollers to liquid and soul

press.title: How to Build a Thriving Drum & Bass Scene in India Feat. The Untitled One
